name: skill-factory
description: Bundle for routing, hardening, analyzing, skillifying, proving Codex skills, and attaching local references to Codex system authoring skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route, create, harden, analyze, skillify, and install Codex skills
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin package that exposes skill-factory-router, skill-refactor, and skillify as Skill Factory lifecycle lanes, while extending the Codex .system skill-creator and skill-installer with local Skill Factory references and evals. Use it to route ambiguous skill work, harden existing skills or plugins through the current router-selected workflow, analyze session and evaluation evidence, capture repeatable workflows, and prove runtime visibility.
defaultPrompt: Help me create or improve a Codex skill.
